37766055.clinical_problem: detecting isthmic spondylolysis (a pars fracture common in adolescent athletes) using deep-learning-aided ultrashort echo time MRI, to reduce reliance on CT radiation in young subjects
37766055.patient_population: proof-of-concept study using ex vivo cadaveric spine specimens; target clinical population is adolescent athletes with persistent low back pain
37766055.model_description: Input: ultrashort echo time (UTE) MRI of the spine; output: (1) synthetic CT-like images and (2) saliency maps of fracture probability, to aid visual detection of pars fractures.
37766055.dataset_size: ex vivo cadaveric spine specimens (proof-of-concept, exact N not stated)
37766055.headline_result: CT-like images vs. UTE MRI (relative to CT reference): lower MSE (0.038 vs. 0.0528), higher PSNR (28.6 vs. 16.5), higher SSIM (0.73 vs. 0.68)
37766055.study_design: proof-of-concept study on ex vivo cadaveric spine specimens

37958265.model_family: multiple ML models (LASSO, radial basis function network, multilayer perceptron, gradient-boosted decision tree; LASSO best)
37958265.clinical_problem: predicting longitudinal craniofacial growth from earlier cephalometric radiographs in children, for orthodontic treatment planning
37958265.patient_population: 59 Japanese children (27 boys, 32 girls) without prior orthodontic treatment, ages 6-12 at baseline
37958265.model_description: Input: coordinated skeletal landmark, linear, and angular parameters from lateral cephalometric radiographs (ages 6-12); output: predicted values of the same parameters at age 13.
37958265.headline_result: Best model (LASSO): prediction accuracy up to 97.87% (linear parameters) and 94.45% (angular parameters) at age 13
37958265.study_design: retrospective longitudinal model development and validation

37968159.clinical_problem: scoping review of AI/ML/DL use for assessing skeletal (bone) age in healthy individuals, relevant to orthodontics and pediatric endocrinology
37968159.patient_population: healthy individuals undergoing bone age assessment (19 articles reviewed)
37968159.model_description: Scoping review of 19 studies using AI/ML/DL (most commonly the BoneXpert automated software, plus other deep-learning and machine-learning models) on hand-wrist radiographs, MRI, and cervical-vertebrae cephalograms to assess skeletal/bone age.
37968159.headline_result: Automated methods found as reliable as manual assessment across the reviewed studies

38001240.model_family: radiomics with decision tree, logistic regression and support vector machine (nomogram)
38001240.clinical_problem: predicting MYCN amplification status in pediatric neuroblastoma noninvasively using 18F-FDG PET/CT
38001240.model_description: Input: 18F-FDG PET/CT images plus clinical and radiological features; output: a clinical-radiological-radiomics nomogram predicting MYCN amplification status.

38054056.model_family: advanced machine learning models allowing non-linear relationships and modeling disorder interdependencies (vs. traditional linear models)
38054056.clinical_problem: predicting 10 psychiatric disorders (e.g., depression, bipolar disorder, ADHD) in children from structural brain MRI
38054056.patient_population: 6916 children aged 9-10, multicenter Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD) study
38054056.model_description: Input: 136 regional brain volume and cortical thickness measures from structural MRI; output: predicted presence of each of 10 psychiatric disorders, using advanced non-linear, interdependency-modeling machine learning.
38054056.headline_result: ADHD detected with AUROC 0.567 (p=0.002) and bipolar disorder with AUROC 0.551 (p=0.002) using advanced models; traditional models detected only ADHD (AUROC 0.529)
38054056.study_design: large-scale cross-validated classification study with permutation testing

38083494.model_family: conditional generative adversarial network (cGAN) using class activation maps as prior
38083494.clinical_problem: generating synthetic fetal-head standard-plane ultrasound images to augment limited annotated training data for classifiers that support diagnosis of neural anomalies during gestation
38083494.patient_population: fetal ultrasound (largest publicly available fetal head standard plane dataset)
38083494.model_description: Input: class activation maps from a fetal-head-standard-plane classification algorithm, used as a conditional prior; output: synthetic realistic ultrasound images of three standard planes (trans-cerebellum, trans-thalamic, trans-ventricular) to augment training data.
38083494.study_design: methods development, evaluated via t-SNE visualization

38090385.model_family: 13 machine learning algorithms compared; extreme gradient boosting, random forest, and adaptive boosting best (random forest most accurate)
38090385.clinical_problem: predicting bone marrow metastasis in neuroblastoma noninvasively using MRI radiomics
38090385.model_description: Input: 572 radiomics features extracted from MRI (41 selected); output: prediction of bone marrow metastasis presence, best performance from a random forest classifier.
38090385.headline_result: Random forest: AUC 0.90 (0.86-0.93) training, 0.82 (0.71-0.93) validation; F1 0.82/0.80
38090385.study_design: retrospective radiomics model development and validation

38144472.model_family: deep learning optimized with a custom AI algorithm for joint training and automated feature selection
38144472.clinical_problem: predicting onset of ADHD, oppositional defiant disorder, and conduct disorder in early adolescence using multimodal predictors including structural and functional MRI
38144472.patient_population: children aged 9-10 and their parents, Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD) cohort, followed to age 11-12
38144472.model_description: Input: 5777 multimodal candidate predictors including structural and functional MRI metrics, psychosocial measures, and parent-reported traits; output: individual-level prediction of onset of ADHD, ODD, and CD at 2-year follow-up.
38144472.headline_result: Multimodal models: ~86-97% accuracy, AUROC 0.919-0.996; neural-metrics-only models: ~80% accuracy and AUROC
38144472.study_design: prospective cohort with deep-learning prediction, tested on held-out unseen data

39491304.clinical_problem: estimating 3D fetal pose (anatomical landmarks) from 3D ultrasound to support biometric measurement, plane localization and fetal movement monitoring
39491304.model_description: Input: 3D fetal ultrasound volumes; output: estimated 3D positions of 22 fetal anatomical landmarks (pose), supporting biometric measurement, plane localization, and movement monitoring.
39491304.study_design: methods development and comparison against other pose-estimation methods

34806646.clinical_problem: improving CT angiography image quality (reducing noise while preserving contrast-to-noise ratio) in children with Takayasu arteritis
34806646.patient_population: 32 children with Takayasu arteritis, 9.14±4.51 years old
34806646.model_description: Input: raw CT angiography projection data; output: reconstructed images with reduced noise and improved contrast-to-noise ratio, compared against filtered back-projection and iterative reconstruction.
34806646.headline_result: DLIR-high setting: noise 15.58±3.65 HU, aorta CNR 24.02±4.55 (best among all reconstructions); subjective nasal-cavity score 3.53±0.51

35194075.model_family: random forest classifier on radiomic features
35194075.clinical_problem: noninvasively diagnosing pediatric cervical lymphadenopathy etiology (non-tuberculous mycobacterial vs. pyogenic vs. reactive/proliferative) via CT radiomics
35194075.patient_population: 249 lymph nodes from 143 CT scans of pediatric patients with lymphadenopathy, Montreal Children's Hospital, 2005-2018
35194075.model_description: Input: CT images of cervical lymph nodes; output: classification into pyogenic, non-tuberculous mycobacterial (NTM), reactive, or proliferative lymphadenopathy, using the 10 most discriminative of 1231 extracted radiomic features.
35194075.headline_result: 4-class accuracy 72%, precision 68%, recall 70%; AUC 89% (NTM vs. all), 90% (NTM vs. pyogenic), 93% (NTM vs. reactive/proliferative)

35233665.clinical_problem: automatically estimating chronological age from knee radiographs in pediatric patients, for forensic, medicolegal, and clinical use
35233665.patient_population: 3816 knee radiographs (training, German population, 2008-2018); 423 (internal validation, 2019-2020); 197 (external validation)
35233665.model_description: Input: knee radiograph; output: estimated chronological age (regression) and binary age-class classification (e.g., <14 vs. >=14 years).
35233665.headline_result: Mean absolute error 0.86±0.72 years (internal) and 0.9±0.71 years (external); AUC 0.94-0.98 for age-class separation
35233665.study_design: retrospective model development with internal and external validation cohorts

35239221.clinical_problem: real-time identification of fetal anomalies via AI-assisted ultrasound
35239221.model_description: Editorial/commentary discussing the current state and future directions of real-time AI-based detection of fetal anomalies on ultrasound (no abstract available).

35289571.exclusion_reason: general clinical review of pediatric heart murmur evaluation/management; AI mentioned only in passing regarding phonocardiography (an audio, not imaging, technology)

35317533.exclusion_reason: commentary on thoracic ultrasound scale-up for TB diagnosis; AI mentioned only in passing as a future consideration, with no AI model developed or evaluated

35341955.model_family: random forest (with backward stepwise regression as comparator)
35341955.clinical_problem: using machine learning on echocardiographic measurements to explain/estimate invasively measured markers of left ventricular diastolic dysfunction in children
35341955.patient_population: 59 children at risk for diastolic dysfunction (Kawasaki disease, heart transplant, aortic stenosis, coarctation of the aorta) undergoing cardiac catheterization
35341955.model_description: Input: echocardiographic diastolic-function measurements, demographic data and clinical diagnosis; output: prediction/explanation of invasively measured diastolic dysfunction markers (tau, LV end-diastolic pressure, max negative dP/dt).
35341955.headline_result: Random forest models noninferior to linear regression; top features included propagation velocity for tau and E/propagation-velocity ratio for LV end-diastolic pressure (no single AUC reported)
35341955.study_design: prospective cohort study comparing echocardiographic and invasive catheterization measures

35455095.exclusion_reason: predicts maternal risk of emergency cesarean section from clinical/demographic variables (fetal sonographic findings only a minor input); not a fetal/pediatric imaging diagnostic AI model

35493614.exclusion_reason: review of Theory of Mind in cognitive science and AI; not diagnostic imaging

35536111.model_family: lightweight deep convolutional neural network with depthwise separable convolution
35536111.clinical_problem: automatic, computationally efficient fetal head circumference measurement from 2D ultrasound to assess fetal development
35536111.model_description: Input: 2D fetal ultrasound images; output: fetal head segmentation, post-processed (morphological processing plus least-squares ellipse fitting) to compute head circumference.
35536111.release_evidence: the code for our method is also publicly available on https://github.com/ApeMocker/CSM-for-fetal-HC-measurement
35536111.headline_result: Mean absolute difference 1.97±1.89 mm; Dice similarity coefficient 97.61±1.72% (HC18 test set)
35536111.study_design: retrospective model development on a public benchmark dataset

35538388.clinical_problem: predicting skull dysmorphology severity and post-surgical outcome in children with isolated sagittal synostosis
35538388.patient_population: 105 infants/children with isolated sagittal synostosis treated surgically
35538388.model_description: Input: preoperative high-resolution CT of the sagittal suture and its anterior/central/posterior sections; output: predicted scaphocephalic severity and post-surgical outcome via radiomics-based logistic regression.
35538388.headline_result: Severity model AUC 0.71, PPV 0.83; outcome model AUC 0.75 (0.61-0.88), NPV 0.95 (0.84-0.99)

35606398.model_family: physics-based numerical simulation (not a trained neural network itself)
35606398.clinical_problem: providing a realistic simulated fetal brain MRI dataset with known ground truth to validate and optimize image-processing algorithms, given the scarcity of real high-quality fetal MRI data
35606398.patient_population: simulated fetal brain data, modeling in utero brain maturation, complementing real clinical acquisitions
35606398.model_description: Input: known ground-truth fetal brain anatomy and stochastic fetal-motion parameters; output: simulated clinical T2-weighted fast-spin-echo fetal brain MR images, used here to validate and optimize a super-resolution reconstruction algorithm and to support deep-learning fetal brain segmentation training.
35606398.release_evidence: open-source Fetal Brain magnetic resonance Acquisition Numerical phantom
35606398.study_design: simulation-tool development with demonstration on a super-resolution reconstruction algorithm

35616956.exclusion_reason: non-radiologic imaging (retinal OCT for retinopathy of prematurity), excluded modality

35658908.clinical_problem: improving image quality of low-dose CT of the paranasal sinuses in children using deep learning image reconstruction compared to iterative reconstruction
35658908.model_description: Input: low-dose paranasal sinus CT raw data; output: reconstructed images at three DLIR intensity levels, compared against filtered back-projection and adaptive statistical iterative reconstruction (ASiR-V).
35658908.headline_result: High-intensity DLIR produced the lowest image noise and best contrast-to-noise ratio and subjective image-quality ranking among all tested reconstructions

35712286.exclusion_reason: dental imaging (orthopantomography/panoramic dental radiograph), excluded modality

35790559.patient_population: pediatric radiology research data subjects (general, multi-institutional AI-enabled research databases)
35790559.model_description: Review of data governance and stewardship principles (privacy, security, bias mitigation, ethical use) for multi-institutional AI-enabled pediatric radiology research databases, summarizing adaptable centralized and distributed data governance frameworks.

35882938.clinical_problem: predicting neonatal respiratory morbidity using prenatal ultrasound-based radiomics texture analysis of the fetal lung
35882938.patient_population: 295 singleton pregnancies, fetal lung ultrasound obtained 28+3 to 37+6 weeks gestation within 72 hours before delivery
35882938.model_description: Input: four-chamber-view fetal lung ultrasound images (20 selected radiomics features) plus 2 clinical features (gestational age, pregnancy complications); output: predicted risk of neonatal respiratory morbidity.
35882938.dataset_size: 295 fetal lung ultrasound images from 295 pregnancies (210 training, 85 testing)

35932003.clinical_problem: predicting risk of spontaneous miscarriage from early-pregnancy ultrasound gestational sac images despite initially positive fetal cardiac activity
35932003.patient_population: 1098 women with early singleton pregnancies, gestational age 6-8 weeks (2196 images, training); two independent test sets of 136 patients/272 images each
35932003.model_description: Input: early-pregnancy ultrasound gestational-sac images; output: predicted risk of spontaneous miscarriage, compared against manual measurement of crown-rump length and fetal heart rate.
35932003.dataset_size: 2196 images from 1098 women (training); two test sets of 136 patients/272 images each
35932003.headline_result: AUC 0.857 (retrospective test), 0.885 (prospective test); accuracy 80.32%/78.1%; manual CRL+FHR AUC only 0.687
35932003.study_design: case-control retrospective study with a prospective validation cohort

35946944.model_family: 3D-ResNet with inception, deep learning with gradient-based backtracking (explainability)
35946944.clinical_problem: identifying structural brain abnormalities to aid early diagnosis of autism spectrum disorder in preschoolers and young adolescents
35946944.patient_population: preschool dataset (110 participants), public ABIDE dataset (1099 participants), and an epilepsy verification dataset (200 participants)
35946944.model_description: Input: T1-weighted structural brain MRI; output: classification of autism spectrum disorder vs. typical development, with a gradient-based backtracking method identifying the brain regions driving each classification.
35946944.study_design: case-control classification study across multiple independent datasets

35966548.exclusion_reason: model uses maternal-fetal electrocardiography (ECG) signals, not diagnostic imaging
